departments.name: Sales
departments.summary: Sales generates business by visiting clients, preparing proposals, and securing signed statements of work.

evidence.quote: Visits clients, prepares proposals, collects signed statements of work and submits travel claims.

work.task: Signs statements of work with clients

evidence.quote: Leads the sales team, signs statements of work with clients and approves the team's travel claims.

work.task: Submits expense claims for client travel

evidence.quote: An Account Manager submits an expense claim within 30 days of the client visit, with the client, the total amount in rupees, the purpose of the trip and the original bills.

departments.name: Delivery
departments.summary: Delivery manages and executes client software projects from initiation through milestone acceptance.

work.task: Assigns Project Managers to client projects

evidence.quote: The Head of Delivery assigns a Project Manager within three working days.

work.task: Raises purchase requests for project needs

evidence.quote: A Project Manager raises a purchase request with the item, the client project, the estimated cost in Indian rupees excluding GST, and the business reason.
When the client accepts a milestone, the Project Manager sends the signed milestone acceptance to Finance.

departments.name: Human Resources
departments.summary: Human Resources oversees recruitment, employee onboarding, policies, and personnel records.

work.task: Handles offer letters and joining formalities

evidence.quote: Handles offer letters, joining formalities and employee records.

When a candidate accepts an offer, the HR Executive sends a new joiner request to IT & Administration at least five working days before the joining date, with the employee's name, role, department, joining date and laptop requirements.
On the joining date, HR sends the joining details to Finance: the employee's bank account, PAN and monthly salary.

departments.name: IT & Administration
departments.summary: IT & Administration manages office facilities, IT equipment and setup, and vendor purchasing.

work.task: Obtains quotations and issues purchase orders

evidence.quote: For purchases above Rs. 50,000/- the IT Executive obtains three written quotations from registered vendors. The Administration Manager selects the vendor and issues the purchase order.

work.task: Sets up laptops, email accounts and access cards

evidence.quote: The IT Executive sets up the laptop, the email account and the access card, and confirms to HR the day before the joining date.
IT & Administration forwards each vendor's GST invoice to Finance.

departments.name: Finance
departments.summary: Finance manages the company's accounts, budgets, vendor disbursements, payroll, and client billing.

evidence.quote: The Accounts Executive matches the invoice to the purchase order and pays the vendor within 30 days.
The Accounts Executive checks the bills and pays the claim with the employee's next monthly salary.
Finance adds the employee to payroll for the joining month.
Finance raises the GST invoice to the client within two working days of receiving the milestone acceptance.
When a client signs a statement of work, the Account Manager sends it to Delivery with the scope, the milestones and the agreed rates.
Approved purchase requests are sent to IT & Administration.
IT & Administration forwards each vendor's GST invoice to Finance.
Approved claims are sent to Finance.

When a candidate accepts an offer, the HR Executive sends a new joiner request to IT & Administration at least five working days before the joining date, with the employee's name, role, department, joining date and laptop requirements.
The IT Executive sets up the laptop, the email account and the access card, and confirms to HR the day before the joining date.
On the joining date, HR sends the joining details to Finance: the employee's bank account, PAN and monthly salary.
When the client accepts a milestone, the Project Manager sends the signed milestone acceptance to Finance.
